description: KILLED 2026-08-08 — premise disproved. Filed on the belief that amending a judgment position overwrites the belief and the ledger is the only history. Both are false: judgment_position_amend writes a NEW revision (judgment-writer.js:2931+), and the store already carries rev numbering, a `supersedes: <slug>#r<N>` chain, and retraction tombstones. Amendment is already non-destructive by construction. The only true residual — position_revision carries transaction time (provenance.written_at) but no valid-time axis, while facts already have one (fact_at) — is a design question, not a data-loss fix, and is re-filed in the ideabox. See docs/features/COMP-JUDGMENT-BITEMPORAL/killed.md
source: Semantica teardown 2026-08-08; re-grounded against code 2026-08-08 after design gate
